method.scope: Function/method bodies in all current 7-provider Python files versus production Python under the 5 pinned OpenBB provider packages.
method.ast_node_count: Raw Python AST nodes in each function body or statement-list block, including nested descendants.
method.block_inventory: Each function body and each nonempty nested body/orelse/finalbody/handlers/cases statement list; blocks smaller than 41 AST nodes excluded.
method.normalization: Locally bound names (function args and stored/deleted identifiers) normalized; call targets, attribute names, keyword names, constants/strings, operators, node types and ordered traversal retained.
method.candidate_filter: Review candidate requires node-count ratio >=0.55, ordered normalized AST-token SequenceMatcher ratio >=0.62, and token-multiset Dice >=0.50. The token stream retains call targets, attribute names, keyword names, constants/strings, operators, node types and order; matching API/schema field names alone does not satisfy both structural thresholds. Shared call/literal/operator counts are reported as diagnostics, not gates.
method.ranking: score = 0.60*ordered token ratio + 0.25*multiset Dice + 0.15*node-count ratio; this is a triage rank, not a finding.
limitations: Heuristic AST screening can miss transformed, reordered, split, or cross-function copying and is not a clone detector.
Common libraries, framework patterns, APIs, and provider schemas can produce structural similarity; candidates need human review.
Only provider source package Python files were scanned; openbb_core, integration tests, documentation, and absent upstream providers akshare/ths were excluded.
Current code hashes cannot establish historical authoring process, clean-room history, or legal/data-rights conclusions.
actions_not_performed: No source code snippets are included in this artifact.
No network/HTTP calls, database calls, tests, or gates were run.
method.nearest_pairs: For each local block with a size/multiset prefilter match, the highest weighted score pair is recorded even when below review-candidate thresholds.
method.score: 0.60*ordered normalized AST-token ratio + 0.25*multiset Dice + 0.15*node-count ratio; ranking aid only, not a finding or legal/provenance conclusion.
